lead.description: a contrast of mean outcomes under two treatments in a stated population

overview_sentence: An [average treatment effect](articles/average-treatment-effect.qmd) is a contrast of mean outcomes under two treatments.

self_checks.title: Null average
self_checks.prompt: Eight patients have 4 deaths under treatment and 4 deaths under no treatment. What is the average treatment effect on the risk difference?
self_checks.answer: The risks are 4/8 and 4/8, so the average treatment effect is 0.

self_checks.title: One changed outcome
self_checks.prompt: After the last treated outcome changes from 1 to 0, 3 of 8 die under treatment and 4 of 8 die under no treatment. What is the average treatment effect?
